@ExiledonMoon The approval-waiting state is particularly useful when several conversations are open. Does Kikumap detect desktop apps as well as browser tabs, and how does it distinguish a completed response from one that is still streaming slowly?

Your AI chats can announce when they're done. Someone finally built the missing Mac app.

Kikumap is a free, open-source Mac menu-bar app that tracks Claude and ChatGPT chats.

• See which pinned chats are running, finished unread or waiting for approval.
• Hear a completion sound, or have it announce which chat finished.
• Drag chats onto a mind map grouped by work, home or side projects.

$0. 382 GitHub stars in 7 days. Works on Intel and Apple silicon Macs running macOS 13 or later. Everything stays on your Mac; it needs Accessibility permission and a one-time "Open Anyway" approval.
